title: 第15章 奖励 王之仪仗第16章 破邪之力驱逐诅咒
slug: 是攻略系统不是攻城略地系统
content_zh:
屋内的异样，让门外的那只怪物也察觉到了一丝不对劲。
原本也只是想要吓唬一下贝儿的怪物此时眉头皱起，猛地抬起爪子朝房门上狠狠一拍。
下一刻木屑飞溅，房门被瞬间打穿一个大洞。
然后就听到门外响起了七嘴八舌的劝谏声：
“哦，王子殿下，您不该这样强行进入一位淑女的房间！”
“殿下，如果您想获得女孩子的好感，就应该收敛您的脾气！”
“我的天啊，城堡中的仆人们现在都没有了灵活的双手，如何维修这道房门显然是个大难题……”
“……”
原本打算先给怪物迎面来一招飞斧的李凯南，在听到外面这些声音之后立刻打消了这个想法。
那些锅碗瓢盆也在外面，可千万别一个不小心把自己的第一桶金给砸坏了……
李凯南透过被砸开的房门向外面看去，只看到一只长着牛角和獠牙，脖子间还有着威风凛凛鬃毛的怪物站在外面。
同时一群会说话的锅碗瓢盆、烛台扫帚，正围着怪物想要阻拦它的无礼之举。
只不过当它们看到贝儿的房间里出现了一位穿着华丽铠甲，手持武器的男人时，全部都愣住了。
“为什么，贝儿小姐的房间里会有男人？”
“贝儿小姐，我想说一位淑女的房间是不应该随便让男人进来的！”
“他是谁？贝儿小姐的恋人？”
“我们好像从来没有过问贝儿小姐有没有爱人？”
“我的天啊，我们不能强行拆散一对相爱的年轻人！”
“是的，即便是为了王子我们也不应该这么做！”
“可是我们可怜的王子怎么办呢，如果找不到真爱，他身上的诅咒就无法解除……”

“……”
被一群锅碗瓢盆包围着的那只人型野兽，此时敏锐地感知到从李凯南身上散发出的恐怖威压。
它脖子间的鬃毛已然全部炸起，整个身体都紧绷了起来。
而它的第一反应则是将自己身边的这群锅碗瓢盆推到一旁，怒吼着命令道：
“你们全都离开这里，立刻！马上！”
然后怪物立刻扭头，对着李凯南亮出了獠牙，喉咙间发出了恐吓的低吼声。
李凯南将这些锅碗瓢盆的对话听得一清二楚，也注意到怪物下意识保护这些锅碗瓢盆的动作。
嗯，这怪物貌似就是那位十年前被女巫施加了魔法的亲王王子？
李凯南思索了片刻，然后将手中骑士剑、战斧全部放下，只用一柄骑士锤迎敌。
这个长着野兽模样的倒霉王子，在看到李凯南身穿铠甲时的尊贵英武、俊朗非凡的样子，第一反应便是不甘和愤怒。
暴虐的情绪不断涌了上来，让它开始失去自己的理智！
如果没有被女巫施加诅咒，他本来也该是这么英武俊朗的，而不是现在这副人人厌弃的野兽模样……
在极端的暴虐情绪加持之下，他的瞳孔彻底变做了兽瞳模样，心中只剩下了野兽嗜血的冲动，朝李凯南猛地扑了过来
content_en:
The strangeness in the house made the monster outside the door also notice that something was wrong.
The monster who originally just wanted to scare Belle frowned and suddenly raised his paw and slapped the door hard.
The next moment, wood chips flew into the air, and a big hole was instantly punched through the door.
Then I heard voices of admonishment coming from outside the door:
"Oh, Your Highness, you should not force your way into a lady's room like this!"
"Your Highness, if you want to win the favor of girls, you should restrain your temper!"
"Oh my God, the servants in the castle don't have flexible hands now. How to repair this door is obviously a big problem..."
"..."
Li Kainan, who originally planned to hit the monster with a flying ax, gave up the idea immediately after hearing the sounds outside.
Those pots and pans are also outside, but don't accidentally smash your first pot of gold...
Li Kainan looked outside through the smashed door and saw a monster with horns, fangs, and a majestic mane standing outside.
At the same time, a group of talking pots, pans, candlesticks, and brooms were surrounding the monster, trying to stop its rude behavior.
But when they saw a man wearing gorgeous armor and holding a weapon appearing in Belle's room, they were all stunned.
"Why is there a man in Miss Belle's room?"
"Miss Belle, I want to say that a lady's room should not let men in casually!"
"Who is he? Miss Belle's lover?"
"It seems that we have never asked Miss Belle if she has a lover?"
"Oh my God, we can't forcefully separate a young couple who are in love!"
"Yes, we shouldn't do this even if it's for the prince!"
"But what about our poor prince? If he can't find true love, the curse on him will never be lifted..."
"..."
The humanoid beast surrounded by a group of pots and pans was now keenly aware of the terrifying coercion emanating from Li Kainan.
The manes on its neck had all exploded, and its entire body was tense.
Its first reaction was to push aside the pots and pans around it and roared an order:
"You all get out of here, now! Now!"
Then the monster immediately turned its head, showed its fangs towards Li Kainan, and let out a threatening growl from its throat.
Li Kainan heard the conversation of these pots and pans clearly, and also noticed the monster's subconscious actions to protect these pots and pans.
Well, this monster seems to be the prince who was bewitched by the witch ten years ago?
Li Kainan thought for a moment, then put down all the knight swords and battle axes in his hands, and faced the enemy with only a knight hammer.
This unlucky prince with the appearance of a beast, when he saw Li Kainan's noble, heroic and handsome appearance when wearing armor, his first reaction was unwillingness and anger.
The violent emotions kept coming up, and it began to lose its reason!
If he hadn't been cursed by the witch, he would have been so brave and handsome, instead of the beast that everyone despises now...
Under the influence of extreme violent emotions, his pupils completely changed into those of a beast. Only the bloodthirsty impulse of a beast remained in his heart, and he rushed towards Li Kainan.
